beedie-beedie:lever:b13f1e19-24b7-4bc2-b.title: Property Management Administrator
beedie-beedie:lever:b13f1e19-24b7-4bc2-b.description: At Beedie, we foster talent, encourage innovation, and reward success. We’re always looking for like-minded people to join our team and share our passion for doing the best work of our lives. Our approach is simple: we work hard, we have fun, and we make a difference. And, we’ve been recognized as a top employer provincially and nationally. Our people are the heart and soul of our organization. If you are passionate, hardworking, ambitious, and want to be part of a dynamic and growing company that will take your career forward, join us. To support the operation and management of the Company’s real estate incoming-producing portfolio by acting as the administrator for the property management department. Responsibilities include portfolio-wide coordination of service and repair requests; preparing, issuing, and tracking purchase orders, contracts, and related documentation; coordinating trades; and maintaining information management system for all department drawings and records. The role also assists Property Managers with the preparation of annual operating cost and capital project budgets and provides centralized administrative support across the portfolio.
responsibilities: Administer and maintain all property maintenance, inspection, and contract documentation, including organizing, filing, and archiving records
Coordinate property and preventative maintenance inspections in support of Property Managers
Administer the Work Order Service Portal system by maintaining tenant contacts, tracking and closing service requests, and ensuring data accuracy
Prepare, issue, and close purchase orders for vendors and internal teams; monitor work progress and confirm tenant satisfaction
Utilize Yardi to generate purchase orders, document maintenance services, and maintain a building asset inventory
Coordinate and communicate with internal teams, Property Managers, and external suppliers and contractors
Support cost tracking by applying appropriate cost accounts and coding for maintenance and project expenses
Maintain a centralized library of building maintenance manuals, drawings, and related technical documentation
Provide general administrative support to the Asset Management Group, including correspondence, filing, reports, and meeting minutes
Assist with planning events, training courses, and seminars for the Asset Management Group
qualifications: A solid understanding of the property and service industry and processes
1-3 years’ experience of administration in property management company
Solid understanding of basic accounting procedures and coding of invoices
Proficient in all aspects of the Microsoft Suite, with an advanced knowledge of Word and Excel
Excellent oral and written communication skills
Familiar with Yardi and Angus is preferred
Have strong time-management skills and are able to work under pressure to meet deadlines
Be detail-oriented and possess clear analytical skills

distro-distro:lever:ff52d5f6-5dae-402e-a.title: Medical Assistant
distro-distro:lever:ff52d5f6-5dae-402e-a.description: Medical Assistant Opportunity – Venice, FL – Up to $23/hr + Great Benefits About Us We're redefining healthcare in Venice, Florida, by seamlessly integrating physical medicine, regenerative medicine, and starting regenerative esthetic procedures. Our state-of-the-art facility boasts cutting-edge equipment and a collaborative team of medical, rehab, and chiropractic professionals, all united to deliver exceptional patient outcomes. Renowned for our fantastic patient reviews and outstanding results, we pride ourselves on fostering a positive, optimistic, and team-oriented culture. If you're passionate about transforming lives through innovative healthcare, we want you to join our family! Why Work With Us? • Be part of a supportive, team-driven environment where collaboration and positivity thrive. • Work with advanced medical technologies in the exciting field of regenerative medicine. • Enjoy professional growth opportunities and a workplace that values your contributions. • Make a meaningful impact on patients' lives in a practice celebrated for its patient-centered care. Position Summary As a Medical Assistant you'll play a pivotal role in our multidisciplinary team, ensuring seamless patient experiences and supporting our providers in delivering top-tier care. This multifaceted role offers the opportunity to work closely with diverse providers and staff, ensuring every day is dynamic and rewarding. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Escorting patients to appropriate treatment rooms and ensuring their comfort. Critical thinking skills. Ability to determine the order of patients being seen in an integrated schedule. Patients are all scheduled to arrive at the same time and will all see each of the 3 providers. It is up to the Medical Assistant to decide which patient will see which provider in order to make sure neither the provider or patient spends time waiting to be seen. Preparing and sanitizing treatment rooms before and after patient visits. Assisting providers with documentation, including accurate SOAP notes. Supporting rehab staff with patient care and facilitating smooth patient flow between in-office treatments. Assisting with advanced procedures, including IV therapies, joint and spinal injections, and regenerative esthetic procedures. Collaborating with front office staff on charting, inventory management, and administrative tasks. Contributing to initial and re-evaluation examinations to support comprehensive patient care. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities We're looking for a positive, enthusiastic, and knowledgeable team player to join our vibrant practice A passion for teamwork, patient care, and embracing a fast-paced, innovative medical environment. Education & Experience Medical Assistant ( MA), Certified Medical Assistant ( CMA) certification, or a Licensed Practical Nurse ( LPN). #HireFinder #LI-PROMOTED #LI-Onsite

embeddingvc-embedding-vc:ashbyhq:c6140da.title: Founder in Residence
embeddingvc-embedding-vc:ashbyhq:c6140da.description: Embedding VC backs engineering, product, and research visionaries building the next generation of AI-native companies. We partner early with founders inventing new paradigms in intelligence — from applied agents to infrastructure to creative computing. We’re opening applications for our Founder-in-Residence (FIR) program — a hands-on residency designed for exceptional builders who are ready to start their next AI venture. You’ll work side by side with our partners in San Francisco Bay Area, exploring new ideas and building from 0→1 with direct support from the Embedding VC network. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Founder-in-Residence, you’ll collaborate with our partners and portfolio founders to define, prototype, and launch a new AI company. You’ll have access to capital, technical talent, and co-building support to accelerate your path from idea to company formation. You’ll: - Work closely with Embedding VC partners to explore high-potential problem spaces. - Prototype rapidly, test assumptions, and validate early traction. - Collaborate with our network of AI researchers, engineers, and operators. - Access funding, design, and recruiting support once your direction is clear. ABOUT YOU - Experienced founder or PM/designer/engineer/growth hacker with a track record of building products end-to-end. - Deep curiosity for AI systems, developer tools, or applied reasoning technologies. - Independent thinker who moves fast, iterates often, and thrives in ambiguity. - Comfortable working in-person part of the week in San Francisco Bay Area. Bonus if you’ve explored: - LLM-based systems, agents, or AI developer tools. - Previous startup founding or early technical leadership experience. WHY JOIN AS FIR - Start your next company with Embedding VC as your earliest partner. - Work in a founder-led environment designed for speed and creativity. - Tap into a strong AI ecosystem of technical advisors and investors. - Hybrid flexibility, with in-person collaboration. Location: Hybrid, Palo ALo If you’re ready to build at the frontier of AI, we’d love to meet you. Apply via Embedding VC to join our next Founder-in-Residence cohort.

Across our family of brands, we support nonprofits, trade associations, and mission-driven organizations with innovative software, impactful marketing strategies, and tools that empower positive change. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: - Stability & Growth: We’re 100% self-funded, with no outside investors or debt, meaning long-term stability and thoughtful growth. - People-First Culture: Our 95%+ employee retention rate reflects our commitment to competitive pay, respect, and career development. - Global Collaboration: Work with talented team members in the US and the Philippines who share your drive for excellence and impact. - Mission-Focused Work: Every role here supports organizations making the world a better place. If you’re ready to grow your career while making a difference, we’d love to hear from you! You’ll receive training on our processes and tools, but we’re looking for someone who can think critically, work independently, and continually find ways to make our sales efforts more effective. jobgether-jobgether:lever:e91a2fef-ebd7-.title: Staff Engineer, Platform & Infrastructure
jobgether-jobgether:lever:e91a2fef-ebd7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Engineer, Platform & Infrastructure based in Spain. This is a high-impact engineering role focused on owning and evolving the infrastructure that powers a modern developer platform. You will take end-to-end responsibility for cloud infrastructure, platform reliability, deployment foundations, and critical data systems. A key focus will be building scalable BYOC and private-cloud capabilities that can serve customers without requiring bespoke engineering for every deployment. You will establish robust Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, observability, security, and compliance practices that enable fast and reliable delivery. The role combines deep technical expertise with product thinking, giving you a direct influence on platform strategy and engineering priorities. You will work within a small, autonomous, remote-first team where ownership, pragmatism, and strong technical judgment are highly valued. This opportunity is well suited to an experienced platform or infrastructure engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and shaping systems at scale. Own and scale the cloud infrastructure supporting the platform, including compute, networking, and core data-layer services. Lead the development and productization of Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) and private-cloud deployments, including provisioning, upgrades, and observability. Build and improve Infrastructure as Code and GitOps foundations that allow a small engineering team to deliver quickly and reliably. Establish reliability as a core platform capability through meaningful Service Level Objectives (SLOs), monitoring, and trusted incident-management practices. Lead the evolution of critical data infrastructure, including PostgreSQL, Redis, Elasticsearch, and ClickHouse as usage scales. Drive infrastructure-related security and compliance initiatives, including SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, penetration testing, and enterprise security reviews. Make architectural decisions that balance scalability, reliability, security, performance, maintainability, and delivery speed. Work with customer-facing and engineering teams to understand infrastructure challenges and turn customer requirements into scalable platform capabilities. Contribute to technical roadmaps and broader company strategy through ownership of major infrastructure and platform decisions. Participate in incident response, help unblock complex technical problems, and raise the engineering standard across the team. Requirements 10+ years of experience in platform engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or related disciplines, with demonstrated experience operating high-traffic production systems. Deep hands-on Kubernetes experience in production, together with strong judgment about when Kubernetes is and is not the appropriate solution. Experience operating software in environments outside your direct control, such as BYOC, single-tenant, on-premises, or air-gapped environments . Strong AWS expertise; experience with GCP and Azure is an advantage. Advanced proficiency with Terraform , including reusable modules, secure state management, and multi-account cloud architectures. Strong database expertise, particularly PostgreSQL , including performance optimization, migrations under load, replication, and operational reliability. Practical experience with compliance and security programs such as SOC 2, ISO audits, penetration testing, and enterprise security reviews . Strong understanding of infrastructure security, observability, incident response, deployment automation, and production operations. Familiarity with TypeScript and Node.js and the ability to understand application-level requirements from a platform perspective. Strong product mindset and developer empathy, with the ability to translate customer problems into effective technical solutions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills

todaytixgroup-todaytixgroup:lever:73ca34.description: About TodayTix Group: TodayTix Group (TTG) is the global e-commerce leader for cultural experiences, designing frictionless discovery and purchase journeys through innovative product design and industry-leading technology. Our portfolio of brands––including TodayTix, New York Theatre Guide, London Theatre, Show-Score, Arthouse, Arthouse London, and Secret Cinema––connects millions of customers with the best in live entertainment. Powered by vast data and insights, TTG helps theatres, producers, and cultural institutions reach highly engaged audiences and unlock meaningful revenue, transforming how tickets are sold across the world. In 2025, TTG entered a new chapter as part of MARI, the global events and experiences company powering world-defining live experiences. Together, we’re expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and accelerating a shared vision to redefine the event lifecycle through seamless discovery, purchase, and engagement. Life at TodayTix Group We thrive in a nimble, growth-oriented environment where adaptability, curiosity, and a bias toward action help us stay ahead of the curve. We move quickly, iterate often, and expect everyone to take ownership of their impact - because we're building the future of live events, and there’s no script for what comes next. New joiners are set up for success with a 90-day onboarding journey, complete with clear goals and measurable milestones. We believe feedback fuels growth, so we hold twice-yearly performance reviews focused on impact and development. Above all, you’ll be working alongside a team of collaborative, passionate, and kind humans - people who love theatre and live experiences, and who support each other just as much as they challenge each other to do great work. We are seeking outstanding applicants of all backgrounds to join our team to bring new voices, talent, and perspectives to the table. We encourage all to apply. About the Role: TodayTix Australia is seeking a Partnerships Manager to enhance and grow our current offering to partners across the Australian portfolio of partners. TodayTix, TTG’s consumer-facing business, continues to grow in strength across 5 Australian markets, offering members access to the best theater and live events across the country. At the same time, TodayTix is also giving producers and event organisers a powerful way to connect with an emerging and engaged audience who are looking for exciting cultural experiences We are seeking someone who is motivated by the live event industry with a sales and partner focused approach. The abilities to keep multiple plates spinning at once and know when to zoom in on a problem or zoom out to take the big picture into consideration are a must. Prior experience in live theatre in the Australian market at the commercial level would be highly desirable. This new position will play a key role in maintaining existing client relationships as well as exploring new opportunities and strategies to grow the offerings to members and partners alike. Reporting to the Senior Director, Sales + Ticketing, the Partnership Manager will be the primary conduit between external stakeholders and the wider local and global TTG team, managing the productions wants and needs with internal capacities to ensure that campaigns are delivered to the desired schedule and opportunities to support various productions are leveraged to return the maximum results for the business and the partnering production or event. The role will work alongside the Marketing, Setup and Programing teams with the primary responsibility of ensuring that everyone has the required information, in a timely manner from start to finish. Please note: this is a full-time, remote role. Qualified candidates must be based in the greater Melbourne area.
responsibilities: Maintain and establish relationships with thoughtful and regular contact with a focus on cementing TodayTix as a premium partner for live performance events across all markets TodayTix operates in Australia.

Manage inbound communication from productions to list content on the TodayTix platform, working with the Senior Director, Sales + Ticketing to determine the suitability and opportunity across a varied portfolio of partners.
Pursuing new partnerships and opportunities to grow the Australian business across the TodayTix marketplace and emerging distribution channels such as Powered by TodayTix.
Working closely with the marketing and partnerships team to develop sales strategies to achieve business goals.
Translate the goals of a production into actionable items for various team members across the organisation.
Ensuring that the deadlines are met and timelines are established internally and externally.
Understand consumer trends to advise and guide productions on how to get the best outcome for their show.
Manage agreements and contracting across a variety of different commercial structures.
In consultation with the global B2B team, utilising TTG technology, lead the development of the growth strategy for B2B distribution partners in the AUS market.
Work closely with the Ticketing Operations team to ensure sufficient inventory to facilitate all offers and promotional activity.
Utilise our AI data and insights tools, to regularly measure and report on partners to continually improve conversion.
Participate in industry events to help drive positive brand and market awareness to highlight TTG’s reputation as industry leaders.
